facts.business: The Indian Hume Pipe Company Limited is engaged in the manufacturing and sale of concrete pipes and the execution of construction contracts, primarily for water supply, sewerage, and irrigation projects, along with operation and maintenance services.

segments.name: Rendering of services - Operation and maintenance income

facts.related_party_note: Related parties include Holding Company (IHP Finvest Ltd.), Ultimate Holding Company (Ratanchand Investment Pvt Ltd), Key Management Personnel (Mr. Rajas R. Doshi, Mr. Mayur R. Doshi), relatives of KMP, enterprises over which KMP exercises control/significant influence (Ratanchand Hirachand Foundation, Walchand Hirachand Foundation, Smt. Pramila Shah Charity Foundation, Walchand Trust, Mobile Systems India Pvt Ltd), and Non-executive Directors. Transactions during FY2025-26 include managerial remuneration, rent paid/received, sitting fees, commission, and other charges.
